integrity: Symbolic exact-arithmetic reproducibility checker included; the analytic root-modulus argument proves all-parameter and all-coefficient assertions. Finite coefficient checks are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification is for ordinary convolution infinite divisibility of the two-component geometric/shape-five negative-binomial model, and its Poisson–XRani specialization. It does not imply thinning self-decomposability or a full classification for other shapes or mixing laws. Publisher HTML renders the original formula placeholders without equations; the original XRani density was cross-verified from the 2023 primary full text. Historical priority remains provisional. Independent audit is not performed.
title: Sharp infinite-divisibility transition for geometric–negative-binomial-five mixtures and Poisson–XRani counts
